text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day at lunchtime, Shinko Windy was 
having lunch with a friend, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wh-Wh-Wh-Nothing is wrong at all! It 
doesn't hurt, not one bi...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I mean, even though it hurts, it's 
not my tooth!! So it's definitely not a 
cavity—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way!! I'm definitely never going to the 
dentist~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although the pain was just caused by 
chewing too much... being forcibly dragged 
to the dentist put her in a terrible mood.
